svg.title: Green Haven V2 — Proposed Geography Concept, Revision 2
svg.desc: Schematic top-down plan of one connected asymmetric floating island inside the proposed 2,000 by 2,000 stud planning boundary. Revision 2 broadens Crystal River into an explorable valley with banks, flats, pools, waterfalls, boulders and wet-grove cues; clarifies route junctions and three crossings; and reserves a broader northern Sanctuary shoulder. All layout details remain proposed and await Gate A approval.
svg.text: PROPOSED GEOGRAPHY CONCEPT · REVISION 2 · GATE A REVIEW

g.text: One landmass · blended shoulders · connected routes
• Meadow Village opens into the lower river
• Whispering Forest rises along the west bank;
Ancient Ruins terrace faces it across the river.
• Verdant Sanctuary crowns the north and blends
down into both west forest and east ruins.
A wide bank corridor opens around the river:
terraced flats, boulder shelves, wet-grove pockets,
linked pools and three falls, from spring to cove.
MAIN · plaza → river walk → pool steps → bridge
ALT A · forest ridge / Elder Tree → upper saddle.
ALT B · lower river → bridge → east terrace / ruins.
HIGH · northern spring ridge / summit bowl
MID · west wooded ridge + east ruins terrace
LOW · southern village basin + lower pools
① Forest Slime King — west basin clearing
② Ancient Guardian — eastern courtyard terrace
③ Verdant Dragon — north summit bowl
Village tower · main falls · broken arch · Elder Tree
Sanctuary now reserves a broad north shoulder for Elder Tree,
exploration terraces, a summit approach and a separate boss bowl.
River flats widen its play space; the five regions remain unequal,
connected and blended. Final sufficiency needs Director review.

svg.text: All region footprints, landmark placements, routes, crossings, source and outlets are SCHEMATIC PROPOSALS. Local grid positions are illustrative only; coordinates and elevations are not approved.
Planning envelope: 2,000 × 2,000 studs. Proposed land span: approximately 1,300–1,600 studs; drawn ≈1,300 × 1,400. Playable surface estimate 0.8–1.1M studs² remains proposed and unverified.
GATE A REVIEW REQUIRED · NO DESIGN OR IMPLEMENTATION APPROVAL IMPLIED
